summary: REQ-1 branding updates appear implemented in key UI/metadata files, but the delivery/export package requirements are only partially met because the new "delivery" folder is placed under frontend/ instead of top-level, and there’s insufficient evidence that a complete project tree (including backend) is generated/listed. The diff also introduces new transaction functionality (localStorage-based) and backend file-management/migration code that were not requested and may conflict with the stated non-goals.

missing_requirements.requirement: Create a top-level delivery/ export package containing (a) a human-readable full project tree/index and (b) documented reproducible regeneration steps/command; listing must include both backend and frontend.
missing_requirements.reason: The diff adds a delivery package under "frontend/delivery/" rather than a top-level "delivery/" folder, and the added PROJECT_TREE.md content shown is only a header with no visible structure listing (and no evidence it includes both backend and frontend).

missing_requirements.requirement: Collect build/deploy problem files into a dedicated subfolder inside the delivery package, with a README explaining each file and why it’s included.
missing_requirements.reason: Problem files are collected under "frontend/delivery/problem-files/" (not under a top-level delivery package as requested). Also, the script only shows copying frontend files; no evidence of backend build/deploy problem files being collected.

missing_requirements.requirement: Stabilize end-to-end build/deploy (frontend build, canister build, deploy) by fixing deterministic causes of intermittent failures; add a short troubleshooting note describing fixes and how to reproduce a successful deploy.
missing_requirements.reason: A troubleshooting document was added, but the diff summary does not provide evidence of concrete fixes to build/deploy determinism (dependency/config/type issues) or that consecutive deployments now succeed reliably.

hallucinated_features.description: Introduced a localStorage-based transactions feature set (types, hooks, UI components, charts) including add/list/summary behavior.
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest explicitly lists as non-goal adding new product functionality beyond publishing/exporting; transactions functionality represents additional product capability.

hallucinated_features.description: Added backend migration module and expanded backend data model/endpoints for user files/transactionFiles management.
hallucinated_features.reason: Not requested by any REQ; also potentially introduces new backend behaviors beyond publishing/exporting scope.

hallucinated_features.description: Added numerous UX/feature copy and screens emphasizing manual entry, visual insights, monthly reminders, etc.
hallucinated_features.reason: These represent additional product/UX enhancements not requested in the BuildRequest (scope limited to naming, delivery export package, problem files, and deploy stabilization).
